project_title: YouTube Ambient Content Factory Command Center

theme_strategy.aesthetic_direction: Tactical Media Command Center with ambient studio glow. Deep charcoal slate surfaces, neon status triggers, precision grid borders, dark-screen relaxation visual cues.

noadsNoise.name: noadsNoise
noadsNoise.focus: Rain, Thunder, White/Brown/Pink Noise, Dark Screen Sleep Sounds

Noadscolors.name: Noadscolors
Noadscolors.focus: Solid Color Screens, Meditation, Chromatherapy & Color Gradients

monospace.usage: FFmpeg render logs, job IDs, Hz frequency readings, audio sample rates, video timestamps, execution time

visual_enhancers.surface_style: Grid-bordered dark glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl)
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Subtle ambient radial light drop behind key metric cards and channel hero sections
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: 1px crisp slate borders with subtle hover highlight to give a technical modular dashboard feel
visual_enhancers.audio_visualizer: Canvas / SVG animated wave bars for rendering and Hz preview monitors

layout_architecture.structure: Fixed collapsible sidebar navigation with studio brand header and sticky top bar containing YouTube OAuth status, live server workload indicator, quick action 'Batch Produce' button, and search.

views.title: Channel Command Overview
views.description: 3 channel cards with channel stats, YouTube sync status, active queue, total generated hours, subscriber & view counters.

views.title: Content Matrix Grid
views.description: Matrix grid mapping Color/Noise type vs Duration (1h, 3h, 8h, 10h, 12h) vs Format (Long 16:9 vs Shorts 9:16) with clear Filled / Missing status badges & direct quick-trigger buttons.

views.title: FFmpeg Video Pipeline Board
views.description: Live job queue board with status stages (Pending → Audio Gen → FFmpeg Rendering → Metadata → YouTube Uploading → Done) with progress bars, live log terminal view, and job action controls.

views.title: Production Generator Studio
views.description: Interactive render studio form: Channel selection, Preset picker (e.g., Deep Sleep Black Screen + Heavy Rain + 432Hz, Pure Emerald 528Hz Binaural), FFmpeg parameters, thumbnail layout customizer, SEO meta auto-generator.

views.title: Asset Gallery & Thumbnails
views.description: Visual grid of generated thumbnails, video previews, color samples, and audio stems with YouTube video link shortcuts.

views.title: Automation Scheduler
views.description: Time-slot grid for automated rendering & uploading calendar (e.g. 02:00 AM daily noise video batch, 14:00 PM Hz Shorts).

views.title: Live FFmpeg & API Logs
views.description: Real-time stream terminal displaying server-side FFmpeg stdout, render speed FPS, YouTube OAuth token health, and worker queue telemetry.

interactive_components: Dialog / Modal for detailed FFmpeg job inspection and manual re-render
Tabs for switching views and filtering channels
Select & Switch for render settings and OAuth config
Progress bar for live FFmpeg render percentage
Badge for video duration, format (16:9 / 9:16), and job status
Sonner toasts for production batch trigger notifications and API sync alerts

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, metric numbers, action buttons, channel cards, matrix cells, job status badges, modal elements, and log entries MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-ready, highly functional Youtube Ambient Content Factory Control Panel.
Support all 3 channels explicitly: noadsNoise, Noadscolors, Noadshertz with tailored branding, badges, and presets.
Ensure the Content Matrix grid clearly highlights missing video combinations and offers one-click generation.
Provide full FFmpeg job pipeline visualization with real-time simulated or backend progress, live log terminal, thumbnail layout generator, SEO metadata editor, and YouTube upload status.
Include a Scheduler view for automated video batch production time slots.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for automated verification.
